spec: Add a second export `splitCents(total, parts)` to the existing module. It splits an integer amount of cents into `parts` integer shares. Keep `formatCents` exactly as it is.
properties: the shares always sum to exactly total, for any integer total including negative ones
the result has exactly `parts` elements, and no two shares differ by more than 1 cent
any leftover cents go to the earliest shares first (larger shares come first)
throws a RangeError unless parts is a positive integer, and a TypeError unless total is an integer
context: The file uses ES module syntax. Keep the existing header comment and formatCents unchanged.
